Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for taking this. We’d like Redwood to send us a single consolidated invoice each month for our account, but with line-level splits so we can post charges to three legal entities and our internal cost centers. High-level requirements: 
- One invoice PDF sent to finance@alphapulse.com each month (preferred on the 1st).
- Line items must be tagged to legal_entity (Alpha US / Alpha EU / Alpha APAC) and to cost_center codes (we’ll include a mapping).
- For Alpha EU we need a reverse-charge VAT note on their tax invoice lines (they are EU VAT registered).
- We prefer to pay via a single ACH/wire to your US bank account and include a remittance file so our AR can auto-apply.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Issue one consolidated invoice with per-line entity tagging?
2) Produce per-entity tax invoices (PDFs) derived from the consolidated file for our internal ledgers?
3) Support a remittance advice/CSV that associates each line to our cost centers?

We can provide a mapping CSV with legal_entity -> remit_to -> tax_id -> cost_center. I’m copying Jacob (Finance) — he’ll help with the mapping.

Appreciate any constraints or lead times you need. We’re targeting a pilot month of June.

Best,

Elena — thanks for the clear summary. Yes, we can support a consolidated invoice with per-line entity and cost-center tagging; we call the internal structure a "virtual allocation matrix." Quick outline of the approach and open items: 

Plan:
- Redwood will generate a single consolidated invoice PDF for Alphapulse (sent to finance@alphapulse.com).
- Each charge line will include metadata fields: legal_entity, cost_center, quantity, unit_price, line_total. These will be visible in the line-item table and exported as CSV (allocation_matrix).
- We can also emit per-entity tax invoice PDFs derived from the same billing run if you require separate legal invoices for posting.
- For EU VAT: we’ll add a reverse-charge note and, where required, include your VAT registration number on the line invoice. However, tax treatment may require us to add or suppress VAT on the Redwood-side depending on legal entity of supply.

Open items / requests from you:
1) Please send the mapping CSV (legal_entity, remit_to_name, remit_email, bank_details or remittance instructions, tax_id, cost_center_codes).
2) Confirm whether you want a single payment to Redwood US with remittance advice to split amounts, or multiple remittance wires per legal entity. Our billing ops can support both but there are ACH/wire minimums and reconciliation implications.
3) Please confirm pilot month (you mentioned June). We’ll need final mapping by May 10 to lock the billing run.

I’ve looped in Kimberly from Finance Ops to spell out any accounting constraints and Marissa from Billing Ops will own the MAP and test run. I’ll attach a short sample split invoice to show the layout.

Next steps:
- You provide the mapping CSV (see attached sample file name expected: allocation_matrix_AP_YYYYMM.csv).
- We’ll run an internal dry-run in mid-May and share the generated PDFs/CSV.

Thanks —

Nikhil / Elena — quick notes from Finance Ops so expectations are aligned: 

Accounting constraints:
- We cannot net VAT between Redwood entities. Each legal entity invoice must reflect the correct VAT treatment for that entity. If Alphapulse pays a single amount to Redwood US, we can still produce per-entity tax invoices for your ledgers, but Redwood’s tax reporting will follow the invoicing/legal entity that bears the supply.
- For reverse-charge lines to Alpha EU, we will add the standard EU reverse-charge statement and include the VAT ID you provide. Those lines will show VAT = 0 with a note referencing reverse charge.
- Our AR can accept one inbound wire/ACH if you include a remittance CSV that matches our allocation matrix (we consume line-level remittance to auto-apply). If multiple remits are easier for you, we can provide per-entity bank rails but that requires separate settlement windows and may delay reconciliations.

Operational asks (to Alphapulse):
1) Provide the CSV with exact cost_center codes and mapping to your GL. Please use the header: legal_entity, cost_center, client_item_id, remit_to, tax_id, prefer_single_payment (yes/no).
2) Provide Alphapulse VAT registration document for the EU entity (we’ll store it in contract artifacts).
3) Confirm whether you require Redwood to issue separate PDF invoices per legal entity at time-of-billing (vs. on-demand extracts).

We will prepare a mutual action plan (MAP) describing: mapping delivery, test invoice date, pilot production month, and AR flow. Marissa will draft the MAP and own the pilot test.
